officialPath.scope: Pi's sole M0-approved public integration route.
officialPath.mechanism: Versioned, release-bound instruction and skill projection only. It does not register an executable Legion tool surface.
officialPath.selectionReason: The authorized current Pi adapter explicitly says native-agent support and MCP registration are unconfirmed. M0 therefore freezes the only source-supported safe path rather than guessing a private configuration format or extension API.
setupBehavior: Detect Pi only from Pi-specific evidence, never from a generic AGENTS.md alone.
Preview and confirm the client-owned instruction/skill projection before mutation.
Install only versioned release-bound projection assets at verified Pi-owned locations selected by the implementation after source-backed client discovery.
Verify that the projected instruction/skill entry is present and records Baseline fidelity.
Report no executable Legion workflow, MCP server, native tool, Arcane enforcement, Audit execution, or Research execution.
officialPath.removeBehavior: Remove only verified Legion-owned projected assets and restore no unrelated Pi state; runtime package uninstall and state purge remain independent actions.

Unavailable.condition: The instruction/skill projection cannot be installed without an ownership conflict, path escape, unverified client location, or an unrelated configuration overwrite.
Unavailable.behavior: Make no active partial write; report the blocking evidence and remediation.

DegradedOrFullPromotion.condition: A supported Pi-native mechanism is discovered and independently qualified.
requiredEvidence: official supported Pi installation or registration contract
verified client-owned integration path and ownership
release-binding handshake before tools are exposed
MCP initialization, reuse, cancellation, restart, and shutdown evidence where executable access is claimed
RightKit AX evidence if Agent Plugins is selected
DegradedOrFullPromotion.rule: A promotion is a new M1-M8-owned change; it must not retroactively reinterpret this M0 Baseline contract.

bridgeRule.status: not authorized by this M0 contract
bridgeRule.mayBeIntroducedOnlyWhen: A verified Pi extension model requires a bridge and no higher-fidelity supported native plugin, Agent Plugins, or native MCP/config mechanism can satisfy the qualified route.
bridgeRule.processRule: If later qualified, Pi may own one reusable client-owned legion serve --stdio process per active session, never an idle daemon or a per-tool Legion runtime birth.

mechanicalAdapterProof.required: Any future Pi adapter is inspectable as detection, registration, path, process lifecycle, verification, repair, and cleanup only.
mechanicalAdapterProof.negativeProof: No adapter module may contain a capability catalog, routing policy, Audit or Research logic, Arcane policy evaluator, work-graph model, receipt semantics, or another Legion runtime.

currentSourceEvidence.finding: Current source offers AGENTS.md instructions and .agents/skills projection but marks native agent and MCP mechanisms unconfirmed.
currentSourceEvidence.disposition: The current descriptor is evidence for Baseline-only status, not a source of target executable configuration.

currentSourceEvidence.finding: Current descriptor engine includes projection and client config mutation machinery in Node.
currentSourceEvidence.disposition: Do not port Legion semantics from this retired shape; target setup/adapters are Rust-owned and mechanical.

blockingEvidence.reason: Baseline requires no unverified Pi executable/private configuration evidence. Promotion to an executable Pi integration is blocked until the promotion evidence set is available.
blockingEvidence.effect: Does not block the M0 Baseline contract; blocks only Pi Degraded/Full executable implementation and claims.
